paragraphs: Rabbi Yose bar Avin: Moed Katan 20b, Rav Ashi’s student; previously he was Rabbi Yose of Yukrat’s student, see there. His colleague was Rabbi Yose ben Zevida; Rav Gaza; Rabbi Hillel was his son-in-law. In Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot. Rabbi Yosef. Rabbi Yitzchak bar Mari was before him, as was Rabbi Yitzchak Kaskasaa. Rabbi Sheizvi spoke to him. There is Rabbi Yitzchak bar Avin, perhaps his brother.
